relationships.evidence_quote: We show that 0.01 µM AM404 reversibly inhibited the evoked AP firing, and 1 µM AM404 completely abolished AP firing in TG and DRG nociceptor neurons

relationships.subject: AM404
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that AM404 by itself is sufficient to reduce acute and subacute inflammatory pain.

relationships.subject: 4-aminophenol
relationships.evidence_quote: Indeed, exposing isolated trigeminal ganglia (TG) to 4-aminophenol leads to AM404 generation in a concentration-dependent manner

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: However, pretreatment with TRPV1 inhibitor capsazepine does not affect the AM404-mediated blockade of AP firing and attenuation of nociceptive responses (SI Appendix, Fig. S6).

key_findings: Peripheral sensory neurons produce AM404 from 4-aminophenol; AM404 inhibits Nav1.8 and Nav1.7 via the local anesthetic site, abolishing nociceptor firing.
Intraplantar AM404 raises pain thresholds and reduces formalin- and CFA-induced hypersensitivity independent of TRPV1.
